headline: PHP and WordPress Developer
summary: PHP developer with three years of experience building and looking after WordPress and custom PHP sites for resorts, schools and small shops in La Union and Pangasinan. I handle theme customisation, MySQL databases and on-page SEO, and I explain options to business owners in plain terms.
skills: On-page SEO and Google Search Console
Client communication in English, Filipino and Ilocano

experience.title: PHP Developer
bullets: Built 14 WordPress sites for surf resorts and inns along the La Union coast, each with a custom booking-inquiry form.
Wrote a PHP plugin that pulls room rates from a MySQL table so owners update prices in one place.
Raised page-speed scores on five client sites by compressing images and removing unused CSS.
Set up on-page SEO for a surf school, which reached the first page for its main local search term within four months.
Walked owners through quotes, timelines and hosting renewals before each project started.

experience.title: Web Developer
bullets: Maintained PHP enrollment and payment-reference forms for a private high school.
Moved a hardware store's product catalogue from spreadsheets into a WooCommerce shop.
